name: الخياطة العربية
note: Gate 2: 'Arab Tailoring' resolves to bespoke tailoring/sewing SERVICE shops (custom abayas/dresses), which is an excluded service like salon/interior-design; with no domain there is no evidence of a substantial retail e-commerce arm, so Gate 7 defaults OUT.

name: SleepTimeKsa
note: The batch domain is dead, but the Gate 4 follow-up finds the live brand site (sleeptimesa.com), a Saudi mattress maker/retailer with ~25 mattress SKUs only; mattresses-only is an explicit Gate 3 narrow-category/low-repeat fail, so OUT still holds.

name: Wallan Trading Company
note: Gate 2 automotive: confirmed leading Saudi car distributor (Renault, Hyundai, Genesis, Geely, Lotus, Zeekr) plus aviation/real estate, with no consumer-retail arm in an approved category.

name: alrifaisaudi
note: Gate 1 resolves to PASS: Al Rifai Saudi is run by Gulf Trading Holding Company (Riyadh-HQ'd, 120+ outlets since 1998, in-country roasting), a local operator running a franchise brand (Cenomi/Jarir precedent); nuts/coffee is high-repeat F&B and the original pass already confirmed a live cart/checkout, so the geography Hold was over-conservative.

name: United Yousef M Naghi Co. Ltd
note: Gate 6 mixed conglomerate: combines retail-qualifying electronics/EDDY home-appliances lines with hard-excluded tyres (automotive), hospitality (restaurants) and IT services; the mixed parent is excluded and the retail line (EDDY) is captured as its own separate row.

name: saadeddin
note: The 'single-bakery scale' reason is factually wrong: Saadeddin Pastry is one of Saudi's largest confectionery chains (145-150+ branches since 1976) with a consumer ordering app (App Store + Google Play) and its own Taker.io online store plus HungerStation; passes Gates 1-5 as high-repeat Saudi F&B.

name: مخابز وحلويات نعمه
note: The 'placeholder page' exclusion skipped the Gate 4 follow-up; Neamah Bakery & Sweets is a real 8+ branch Jeddah/Mecca chain with its own branded online ordering (neamah.my.taker.io) plus HungerStation, an approved high-repeat F&B category with genuine Saudi multi-branch scale.

name: شركة البترول الوطنية الكويتية Kuwait National Petroleum Company
note: Gate 2: state-owned oil-refining/energy company, not consumer retail; even downstream fuel is a hard exclusion.

name: Jazeera Pharmaceuticals Industries
note: Gate 2: confirmed pharmaceutical manufacturer (Riyadh, est. 1999, US FDA-certified, cephalosporins/penicillins, contract manufacturing), i.e. manufacturing/healthcare, not a retail pharmacy chain.

name: منتجات فورايفر الامريكية في العراق والعالم
note: Gate 1 geography: the name declares Iraq focus ('in Iraq and the world') and it is a Forever Living MLM distributor, not a KSA/Kuwait/Qatar retail storefront; no domain to verify (Gate 7 OUT).

name: al-araba
note: Gate 2 automotive: AL ARABA Group is a Saudi vehicle-customizing/armoring business (maker of the 'Al Araba 1' car); the keyword cart/checkout hit was a false positive from a car-customization site.

name: FAHES SA
note: Gate 2 B2B services: Saudi conformity-assessment and product inspection/testing firm (SABER/FASAH certification), not retail, consistent with its testing-lab/consulting NAICS codes.

name: ptc
note: Gate 7: 'PTC' resolves only to non-retail Saudi entities (public transport, contracting, oil/energy trading); no live consumer-retail site is findable, so it defaults OUT.

name: Otantik Home
note: Gate 1 geography (correcting the weak wholesale-keyword reason): Turkish-origin home-decor/giftware brand ('Turkish translation of Authentic-Home,' expansion 'starting from Turkey' across 12 countries with identical multi-country storefronts); the Qatar site is a storefront node of a foreign-HQ'd brand, so it stays OUT.

name: Binzagr Company
note: Gate 2 wholesale/distribution: one of Saudi's largest FMCG distributors/logistics operators (800 trucks, ~15,000 trade customers/day) connecting brands to retailers, with no dedicated consumer-retail arm of its own.

name: tomatostores
note: Gate 1 geography: Tomato is a 100% Egyptian fashion brand (Alexandria HQ, est. 1994); the .sa is dead and the only live storefront is Egyptian-operated, so the operating entity is foreign-HQ'd.

name: Al Ghazali  |  الغزالي
note: Gate 3 narrow-category: independently confirmed watches-only store (11 watch brands, no jewellery) with real SAR e-commerce and branches; a single narrow line with inherently low repeat-purchase, a defensible fail since jewelry passes on breadth (rings/earrings/necklaces) that a watches-only store lacks.

name: zgames
note: Gate 1 geography: ZGames/ZamZam Distribution is a UAE-headquartered group (first office UAE 1998) running one shared platform across the GCC; fails geography despite otherwise passing Gates 2-5.

name: مجموعة عادل كير الطبية
note: Gate 2 healthcare services: the site offers only home-visit care (nursing, physiotherapy, home diagnostics) with an appointment CTA and no product catalog or pharmacy storefront; only retail pharmacy chains pass, not home-care services.

name: Saleh Al-Othaim Investment Co | شركة صالح عبدالله العثيم للاستثمار
note: Gate 6/Gate 4: diversified investment holding (real estate, financial, IT, plus luxury restaurants/cafes), distinct from Al-Othaim Markets, with a corporate site and no transactional retail storefront.

name: Juffali Technical Equipment Company
note: Gate 2/Gate 4: JTECO is an industrial/technical-equipment distributor (Bosch/Karcher power tools, forklifts, workshop and industrial-cleaning equipment) inside the Juffali industrial group; hardware/industrial category and its online store is dead with no live consumer e-commerce found.

name: Ibin Ajayan Trading Group
note: Gate 2: diversified Qatari B2B trading conglomerate (IVECO/Ashok Leyland/Golden Dragon vehicles, forklifts, cranes, tyres, industrial oil, plus transport/catering/security); automotive and wholesale trading are both hard fails with no consumer retail.

name: Almunajem Foods Company
note: Gate 2: major Saudi food importer/distributor selling to ~18,000 supermarkets and ~1,000 wholesale/food-service clients via 14 cold-storage branches; a B2B distributor with no dedicated consumer-retail store of its own.

name: modpatisserie
note: Gate 2/Gate 4: despite the 'patisserie' name, its own site describes a primarily B2B bakery-supply/logistics operation (centralized kitchen, temperature-controlled fleet, 'B2B supply') with no consumer cart/checkout, so the logistics/B2B exclusion holds.
